bullets.text: Instagram’s First Draft Simplifies Reels Editing - **Instagram** introduces a feature that automates video editing, saving creators time.
Uber Enhances Teen Ride Safety - A new live video feature allows parents to monitor their teens' Uber rides in real time.
Pixel 11’s Rambler Voice-to-Text Impresses - **Google**'s new tool effectively processes speech, but lacks live preview functionality.
Claude Memory Unification by Anthropic - **Anthropic** streamlines memory features across Claude Cowork and chat for improved user experience.
AirTag 2 Price Drops to $20 - **Apple**'s latest tracking device sees significant price reductions ahead of new features.
